arabic text: AA JAO CHAAND MERE, TERI PYAAS MEIN BUJHAAON
english translation text: COME, MY MOON, LET ME QUENCH YOUR THIRST

arabic text:
MERE LAADLE KAHAN HO
SEENE TUMHAIN LAGAAON
english translation text:
WHERE ARE YOU, MY BELOVED CHILD
LET ME HOLD YOU TO MY CHEST

arabic text:
BETA TUMHARA QAATIL, MERE SAAMNE KHADA HAI
JAANE KYUN HANS RAHA HAI
CHAADAR BHI LUT CHUKI HAI
MUH KIS TARHAN CHUPAAON
english translation text:
MY SON, YOUR KILLER STANDS BEFORE ME
I DO NOT KNOW WHY HE IS LAUGHING
EVEN MY VEIL HAS BEEN PLUNDERED
HOW CAN I HIDE MY FACE

arabic text:
TERE JHOOLE KO SAKINA, RO RO KE CHOOMTI HAI
TUJHE GHAR MEIN DHOONDTI HAI
TERI MAUT KI KHABAR MAIN
KAISE USE SUNAAON
english translation text:
SAKINA KISSES YOUR CRADLE, WEEPING
SHE SEARCHES FOR YOU IN THE HOUSE
THE NEWS OF YOUR MARTYRDOM
HOW CAN I TELL HER

arabic text:
MERI JAAN JAA RAHI HAI, YE SOCH SOCH ASGHAR
IS PHOOL SE GALE PAR
YE TEER KAISE JHELA
BEHNON KO KYA BATAAON
english translation text:
MY LIFE IS SLIPPING AWAY, ASGHAR, THINKING
HOW THAT ARROW WAS BORNE
BY THIS FLOWER-LIKE THROAT
WHAT SHALL I TELL YOUR SISTERS

arabic text:
NAIZE SE GHIR RAHA HAI, NANNA SA SAR TUMHARA
DIL ROTA HAI HAMARA
MERE HAATH TO BANDHE HAIN
SAR KIS TARHAN UTHAAON
english translation text:
YOUR TINY HEAD IS SURROUNDED BY SPEARS
MY HEART WEEPS
MY HANDS ARE TIED
HOW CAN I LIFT YOUR HEAD

arabic text:
JHOOLE KE SAATH BETA, MERE HAATH JAL GAYE HAIN
ZAALIM BHI HANS RAHE HAIN
TERI AAKHRI NISHAANI
KIS TARHAN SE BACHAAON
english translation text:
MY SON, MY HANDS HAVE BURNT ALONG WITH YOUR CRADLE
THE OPPRESSORS ARE LAUGHING TOO
YOUR FINAL KEEPSAKE
HOW CAN I SAVE IT

arabic text:
JAB RAAT HOGI RAN MEIN, HO JAAYEGA ANDHERA
DARNA NAHI AY BETA
DAADI KAHAINGI TUM SE
AA MAIN TUJHE SULAAON
english translation text:
WHEN NIGHT FALLS ON THE BATTLEFIELD, DARKNESS WILL DESCEND
DO NOT BE AFRAID, MY SON
YOUR GRANDMOTHER WILL SAY TO YOU
COME, LET ME PUT YOU TO SLEEP

arabic text:
TUM RAAT KO HAMESHA, SUNTE THE MAA SE LORI
AB NEEND AATI HOGI
PHIR GODH MEIN LITA KAR
NAAD-E-ALI SUNAAON
english translation text:
EVERY NIGHT, YOU WOULD LISTEN TO YOUR MOTHER'S LULLABY
NOW SLEEP MUST BE COMING TO YOU
LET ME LAY YOU IN MY LAP AGAIN
AND RECITE NAAD-E-ALI TO YOU
